> CREATIVE CODING ART

MATCHING RECORDS: 6

  • Grainrad:
    A browser-based image and video effects engine powered by WebGPU that processes ASCII, dithering, and retro-style shader effects locally at 60fps with export support for video, GIF, SVG, and Three.js scenes.
  • Space Type Generator:
    A browser-based kinetic typography playground by Kiel Mutschelknaus that lets you manipulate text in real-time 3D space across multiple generation modes with zero paywalls, logins, or tracking friction.
  • Spelunkr TV:
    A zero-signup, open web-based streaming platform that curates public domain and Internet Archive VHS tapes into a live channel guide featuring retro programming, original commercials, and community access content.
  • Floor796:
    An ever-expanding, client-rendered pixel-art animation scene showing life on a fictional space station floor, featuring thousands of pop-culture references, interactive mini-quests, and zero paywalls.
  • OpenProcessing:
    A creative coding platform and community sandbox for writing, prototyping, sharing, and rendering algorithmic art using Processing, p5.js, and WebGL directly in the browser.
  • Zoomquilt:
    A classic collaborative web art project created by Nikolaus Baumgarten that continuously renders an infinite, seamless zooming vector illustration in the browser.
